title: 温蒂汉堡秒拒收购：20年股东被挡门外，戴夫之道能否翻盘
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Why do you think that they rejected this bid? Is it because they think that Wendy's could be worse more?
segments.zh: 你认为他们为何拒绝这一报价？是因为他们觉得Wendy's的价值可能更高吗？

segments.en: Yes. This is very interesting to me, in part, because of just how quickly this rejection came.
segments.zh: 是的。这让我觉得很有趣，部分原因是这一拒绝来得太快了。

segments.en: So it was just over a week ago that Trian announced that they were making this bid.
segments.zh: 就在一周多前，Trian宣布他们提出了这一报价。

segments.en: This is a company that's been worth a heck of a lot more, you know, just in the last few years.
segments.zh: 这家公司过去几年的市值曾远高于此。

segments.en: Of course, it has been struggling, so it is clearly an opportunistic one on the part of Trian.
segments.zh: 当然，它一直在挣扎，所以这显然是Trian的机会主义行为。

segments.en: But I think they're going to have a hard time, I think, running a proxy flight here to the extent they want to do that, and the fact that Nelson Peltz has been invested
segments.zh: 但我认为他们要想发起代理权争夺战会很困难，而且Nelson Peltz已经**这家公司

segments.en: in this company for 20 plus years.
You know, if he wanted to sort of influence this company, has a strategy for turning it around.
segments.zh: 如果他想影响这家公司，他有扭转局面的策略。

segments.en: He's been their biggest shareholder for quite a long time, you know, kind of where has he been?
segments.zh: 他长期以来一直是他们最大的股东，那么他之前都在哪里呢？

segments.en: Is the natural sort of counter? Well, this isn't the first time that they've made a run at Wendy's, right?
segments.zh: 这是自然的反击吗？嗯，这不是他们第一次对Wendy's发起行动了，对吧？

segments.en: I mean, what's been going wrong at Wendy's? Why has it been lagging some of its other peers and what might Trian do differently to try to get it ahead of them?
segments.zh: 我的意思是，Wendy's出了什么问题？为什么它落后于其他同行，Trian可能会采取什么不同的做法来试图超越他们？

segments.en: Yeah, and interestingly, this morning, along with announcing this rejection, reporting earnings, also announcing a strategic plan called A Dave's Way,
segments.zh: 是的，有趣的是，今天早上，在宣布拒绝的同时，还公布了财报，并宣布了一项名为“戴夫之道”的战略计划，

segments.en: that's a reference to Dave Thomas, of course, the founder, the relatively new CEO at Wendy's.
segments.zh: 这当然是指创始人戴夫·托马斯，以及Wendy's相对较新的CEO。

segments.en: I think this is his third or fourth stint with the company.
segments.zh: 我认为这是他在公司的第三或第四个任期。

segments.en: So he both knows the company quite well.
segments.zh: 所以他对公司非常了解。
